name: mcp_security_validate_mcp_server_entry
notes: MCP server-entry IOC/security validator (real port src/hermes_cli/mcp_security.c linked via extra_src; harness traces a verbatim copy of the port body and asserts byte-equality with the real fn's output each input — exit 3 on drift). Twin imports LIVE hermes_cli/mcp_security.py::validate_mcp_server_entry and mirrors the same rung order, asserting the traced value equals the LIVE issues list. Covers: clean uvx entry, IOC in args (key/hermes-0day/source IP), IOC via env value, quoted-path command basename (/bin/bash), egress-only, egress+exfil-hint, persistence-only, egress+persistence (two-issue ordering), shell with no matching payload, shell with no script, non-dict entry. Regex translations are POSIX-ERE equivalents; inputs avoid known boundary gaps (word-bounded POST vs substring, crontab\b, numeric args str()%g formatting).
